description: Integrate Percy visual testing into a new project and demo visual change detection step by step. Primary tool for "Integrate percy in this project".

filePaths.description: Absolute paths of specific UI test files, instead of folders. If omitted, folderPaths is used.

folderPaths.description: Absolute paths of folders with UI tests. If omitted, scan the codebase for them; [] if none.

integrationType.description: 'web' (Percy Web) or 'automate' (Percy Automate). If unspecified, ask the user; never default.
